description: Actual SWARM Wallet application UI compiled with its existing development review harness. No UI components redrawn or modified. Screenshot data is synthetic and nonfunctional.
build_method: Existing tools/build-harness.js using application webpack, src/devHarness/index.tsx and HarnessRoot.tsx. Private pre-loader changes display fixtures and buildProfile profile only; native, IPC, filesystem and shell remain stubbed.
fixture_changes: Select existing swarm-mainnet build identity; keep all real UI component code unchanged.
Replace mock fixture wallet chain with swarmMainnetChainName and server label lwd-main.swarm.green; no network request is made.
Unified demo address: swm bech32m encoding of 96 zero words with correct string checksum; NOT a valid Unified Address container, no key or account.
Transparent demo address: s1 plus 32 capital Q characters, prefix-shaped only, not a generated payment address or account.
Existing mockAppState.ts balances, transfers and historical mockSwmPrice fresh data retained. Date frozen only for stable rendering.

behavior.overview: Actual OverviewScreen with historical price fixture.
behavior.send: Actual SendScreen empty draft; no native fee or proposal response is invented, no confirmation performed.
behavior.receive: Actual ReceiveScreen simultaneously shows unified/shielded and transparent fixture cards. No invented mode toggle.
behavior.activity: Actual ActivityScreen with first shielded received fixture row selected.

isolation: Fresh browser context. Requests outside localhost harness blocked. No owner wallet, application user data, keychain, native module or transaction accessed.
